Herbal Remedies 



 About Low Sperm Count 
 The problem of low sperm count is known as Oligospermia. It occurs when the semen (fluid), a men ejaculate, during an orgasm contains less sperm than normal. The sperm count is considered low when a man has less than 15 million sperm per ml of the fluid. The problem reduces the odds that one of sperm will fuse the egg and in turn the problem results in difficulty in pregnancy. 
 What are the symptoms? 
 The common symptoms of this problem are listed below:- 

 Inability to conceive a child 
 Sexual problems such as low sex drive 
 Difficulty in maintaining erection 
 Pain and swelling in testicle area. 
 Decreased growth of body hair. 

 What are the causes? 

 Sperm production is a complex process in which normal functioning of testes, hypothalamus and pituitary glands is required. Problem with any of them results in sexual problem including low sperm count. 
 There can be problem with the shape or movement of the sperm. 
 Medical problems can also lead to this problem. 
 Environmental factors such as exposure to chemicals, metals or radiations may also cause the same. 
 Unhealthy Lifestyle is another cause of this sexual problem. 
 The problem may be genetic also. 
 Stress, depression or anxiety. 

 What are the risk factors? 
 Common risk factors of low sperm count are listed below :- 

 Smoking and drinking alcohol 
 Use of drugs 
 Obesity 
 Infection 
 Exposure to the toxins or harmful radiation. 
 Injury to the pelvis or sexual parts 

 Role of diet 
 Diet plays an important role in each and every disorder. If we are eating healthy, then we are at low risk of getting any health problem. And healthy diet depends on the health of a person. A healthy and balanced diet is required for this sexual problem as well. The diet will help to supply enough nutrients to the body and will help in the normal functioning of the body. 
 Healthy lifestyle 
 Unhealthy lifestyle is also a major cause of this problem. Healthy lifestyle is an important way to manage not only this problem, but also a good option to maintain overall health. A person should stop consuming alcohol as alcohol has a direct effect on the sperm count. Smoking should be avoided. Overweight is another cause of this problem, so a healthy weight must be maintained. Avoid taking illicit drugs. 
 Treatment
